title: Bar widget: dropdown fields overflow the dialog viewbox (right border not visible)
description:
## Summary

In the Omarchy bar widget (`RustApp/quickshell/omarchy/Panel.qml`), the settings input
(dropdown) fields did not fit inside the rendered dialog viewbox: each field's right
border fell outside the visible panel, so there was no vertical line closing the field
box. The dialog's popup card clipped the overflowing rows at the right edge.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Click the AndroidMic mic icon in the Omarchy bar to open the panel.
2. Look at any "AUDIO FORMAT" / "CONNECTION" setting row (Device, Sample rate, Channels,
   Format, Mode, etc.).
3. The dropdown field extends past the right edge of the dialog; its right border is
   not visible / not aligned within the viewbox.

## Root cause

Two interacting layout defects in `Panel.qml`:

- The settings `Column` was sized to `width: panel.contentWidth` (400), but the
  `KeyboardPanel` card insets its content by the popup padding, so the actual scroll
  viewport is narrower. Rows sized `width: parent.width` therefore overflowed past the
  card's visible right edge.
- The `Column` also carried its own `leftPadding`/`rightPadding` (14) on top of the
  card's inset, pushing every row's right edge even further out of view, so each
  field's right border landed flush against / outside the dialog rim.

## Fix

- Bind the settings `Column` (and `Flickable.contentWidth`) to `scroll.width`, the real
  scroll viewport, instead of `panel.contentWidth`.
- Remove the `Column`'s own horizontal padding (the card already insets content), while
  keeping vertical padding so rows don't touch the panel edges. Rows now fill the
  viewport fairly and each field's right border is visible inside the dialog.

Dialog width is unchanged; only alignment/overflow was corrected.

## Notes

- QML-only change: `Panel.qml` in `RustApp/quickshell/omarchy/` (and the deployed copy
  under `~/.config/omarchy/plugins/androidmic.quickshell/`). No Rust rebuild needed.
- Because Quickshell caches QML per URL, a **cold shell restart** (`omarchy-restart-shell`)
  is required for the fix to actually render; a plugin rescan alone leaves the stale
  cached version running. This caching is what made the bug appear to persist after the
  file was already corrected.
notes: Verified: all dropdown fields are now correctly aligned within the dialog viewbox. Each field's right border is visible and neatly inset inside the panel, and the fields line up in a right-hand column (left edge set by the longest label) with a clean label-to-field gap. Fix is live (commits 489aaae, 4bfc8e2, fef471c) after a cold shell restart. Closing as resolved.
